messages:
sasha_sales: Quick sync — MerchantBank wants a short POC to validate BYO CMK + HSM with our private deployment. They need Terraform-managed CMK lifecycle, key rotation every 90 days, and a zero-downtime cutover window. Can eng + sec confirm blockers?
ben_engineering: Sounds doable. Main questions: do they want our key-proxy or direct CloudHSM integration? If direct, networking + cross-account IAM is heavier.
priya_security: They need FIPS 140-2 Level 3 attestation and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. Also ask if we can sign rotation events with attestation metadata.
oliver_solutions: POC scope from sales: 2-week sandbox on Dedicated with customer-managed key. Terraform state will be in their S3. They want a runbook for preflight + cutover checklist.
ben_engineering: For Terraform we support a provider flow: sample snippet:
```
resource "redwood_keystore_cmk" "customer" {
  key_id = "arn:aws:kms:..."
  managed_by = "customer"
  rotation_period_days = 90
}
```
We'll need the KMS key ARN, access role, and SG rules for VPC endpoints.
priya_security: Confirming: we'll require customer to provide key policy allowing our service principal to encrypt/decrypt for inference only, and an explicit "Disable plaintext export" assurance. Also need HSM attestation artifacts.
ben_engineering: Latency impact: adding RPC to KMS per-init increases tail by ~8-12ms on cold starts; we recommend KV-cache prefixing and local ephemeral wrapping to avoid per-token KMS calls. We'll document config toggles.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: private-poc/dedicated-cluster -> canary at 2026-04-01T16:00Z (ETA) :rocket:
oliver_solutions: Preflight checklist draft — quickly:• Customer provides KMS ARN + IAM role• Network: allow outbound to kms endpoints + HSM IPs• Audit: SIEM endpoint + log format• Rotation policy: cron window & grace period• Terraform snippets + secrets storage• Rollback path & fallbacks (our managed key fallback)
sasha_sales: Perfect. Can eng produce IAM policy snippet and a one-page runbook by EOD Wednesday? Also need a pricing delta for Dedicated with BYO-CMK attachment.
ben_engineering: I'll add IAM policy and runbook draft. For pricing: ops team — attaching BYO keys adds a one-time integration fee + small monthly key-management surcharge. @priya_security do we need legal signoff for attestation artifacts?
priya_security: Yes, legal should review attestation transfer + retention. I'll loop legal. Also will add required fields for their security questionnaire (export control, key provenance, attestation stamps).
oliver_solutions: I can draft the pricing blurb. Sales ask: what's our SLA if customer's CMK fails? We currently default to managed-key fallback with opt-in; need to confirm acceptable RTO.
ben_engineering: RTO for fallback: ~5 mins if autoscaling warm pools available; if not, 30–60 mins to reprovision. We'll document canary thresholds.
sasha_sales: Thanks — let's reconvene after runbook + IAM snippets. If anyone hits a blocker ping me. :thumbsup:
